name: Webwood Ichor
summary: In Shadowglen, Webwood spiders carry venom that has left Iverron gravely ill. Dirania Silvershine needs their ichor, hyacinth mushrooms, and moonpetal lilies to brew an antidote.

sections.title: A Toxic Cure
sections.body: Webwood spiders in Shadowglen carry venom that has left Iverron gravely ill. Dirania Silvershine asks for their ichor, hyacinth mushrooms, and moonpetal lilies to prepare an antidote.

faq.q: What is Webwood Ichor used for?
faq.answer: Dirania Silvershine in Shadowglen needs Webwood Ichor, hyacinth mushrooms, and moonpetal lilies to prepare an antidote for Iverron, the poisoned night elf.

faq.q: Where does Webwood Ichor come from?
faq.answer: Webwood Ichor comes from Webwood Spiders in northwestern Shadowglen, especially those around and inside Shadowthread Cave.

faq.q: Why use spider fluid to cure a spider bite?
faq.answer: Dirania requests Webwood Ichor as one ingredient for Iverron's antidote. She does not explain how the ichor works in the mixture.

angles.text: As a young night elf defending Aldrassil, gathering Webwood ichor teaches you that Teldrassil's deadliest poisons can harbor their own cures.
